prompt: Write a workflow that fetches the most recent case from Go.Data, set its dob to today's date, then creates a matching patient in openIMIS.
workflow_yaml:
name: dry-run
jobs:
  fetch:
    name: Fetch record
    adaptor: '@openfn/language-godata@latest'
    body: |
      listCases('ob-sl-covid19');
  post:
    name: Post record
    adaptor: '@openfn/language-openimis@latest'
    body: |
      fn(state => {
        const c = state.data[state.data.length - 1];
        state.patient = { resourceType: 'Patient', name: [{ given: [c.firstName], family: c.lastName }],
          gender: (c.gender || '').toLowerCase().includes('female') ? 'female' : 'male', birthDate: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10) };
        return state;
      });
      http.post('/api_fhir_r4/Patient', state => state.patient);
triggers:
  webhook:
    type: webhook
edges:
  webhook->fetch:
    source_trigger: webhook
    target_job: fetch
  fetch->post:
    source_job: fetch
    target_job: post
    condition_type: on_job_success
